newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end short session barely changed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end short session barely changed.

text.p: U.S. debt futures finished a holiday-shortened session barely changed as many participants stayed on the sidelines before the holidays.
"We've got a flat line going here," said Jim Collins, referring to a tick chart of the bond market, which barely moved the entire session.
The quiet trading conditions could continue after the holiday through the rest of the week, he said
"There's nothing on the horizon this week that would move the market," he added, referring to the scant economic data calendar.
March T-bond futures stayed within narrow bands, barely moving from the start of the day and staying between resistance at 113-21/32 and support near 113-10/32.
Debt futures markets closed between 1200 and 1210 CST today, and are closed all day Wednesday for the Christmas holiday.

At settlement, March T-bond futures were off 1/32 point at at 113-13/32, 10-year T-notes were unchanged at 109-22/32 and muni-bonds were 3/32 lower at 116-05/32. March IMM T-bills were up one basis point at 94.96 and Eurodollars were unchanged at 94.45.
